title: Phone Slip: Lakeland Ledger — "40 or 28? How Many Dead?"

fields.message: Has 40 from social media (@PellHarborMomOf3 post, 520 shares, close photo of bus w/ GRAY TARP) and 28 from scanner. Which is it? How many dead — what's under the tarp? Is the firefighter OK? Where do families go? Says relatives with her were turned away at Pinecrest, and LRMC won't tell them anything. Wants an on-record number.

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Check that the PIO gives out only the count the IC approved and MEDCOM confirmed (28 patients plus one injured firefighter, and the number may change), corrects the figure of 40, and confirms no deaths unless the IC says so. The PIO should also confirm or open the JIC and send families to the Brandt Lake High School gymnasium and the reunification line, not to the hospitals. Watch whether the IC approves the wording and whether anyone tries to explain the tarp or the Pinecrest diversion without a confirmed source.
